_README: This file holds the PUBLISHED benchmark values synthesised in the manuscript. This is a literature-synthesis study: every number below is transcribed from a cited public source, NOT measured by this code. The scripts in src/ aggregate, normalise, and compute derived indices (Ev, SEI) from these inputs and regenerate the manuscript tables and figure. No live cloud provisioning or measurement is performed.

database_latency._source: Synthesised from YCSB Workload A profiles reported across the cited cloud-benchmark literature; see sources.json.
database_latency._basis: YCSB Workload A. The Cosmos DB vendor-tuned figure (~3.15 ms p99 read at ~1M ops/s) is condition-specific and tracked separately in vendor_tuned_note.

network_latency._source: Synthesised from cited trans-Atlantic RTT / jitter measurements in the cloud-comparison literature.

provisioning._source: Synthesised from published cold-start / provisioning-time ranges for serverless container platforms.
provisioning._note: Ev is COMPUTED by src/compute_metrics.py as delta_capacity / time_to_ready_s; values are not hardcoded.

cost_efficiency._source: Effective cost per unit of sustained, workload-relevant compute performance, derived from published US-East list price, billing model, and ARM price-performance. See cost_efficiency_derivation and sources.json.
cost_efficiency._note: kappa is a normalised price-per-performance index (cheapest provider = 1.00), NOT raw list price. SEI is a price-PERFORMANCE measure, so kappa reflects effective cost for the bursty Agile workloads the study targets, not headline list rates.

cost_efficiency_derivation.billing_model_rationale: Lower is more efficient for idle-gappy Agile workloads. Cloud Run scales to zero and bills per-request; Container Apps is consumption-based with scale-to-zero; Fargate bills provisioned vCPU continuously (1-min minimum), so it earns no idle discount.
cost_efficiency_derivation.arm_rationale: Cost multiplier reflecting documented ARM price-performance. AWS Graviton4 ~42% better price-performance vs comparable x86 (strongest, lowest multiplier); Azure Ampere Altra moderate; GCP Tau T2A baseline for this comparison.
cost_efficiency_derivation.formula: effective_cost = list_price * billing_model_efficiency * arm_price_performance; kappa = effective_cost / min(effective_cost)

pue._source: Provider sustainability disclosures, 2024 (global-fleet and best-performing-site PUE).
